```{r}
# List all CSV files in the directory
csv_files <- list.files(path = "/Users/mattparker/Dropbox/Workspace/moops/manuscript1/data/experiment_all/sample_taxon_reports", pattern = ".*.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
seq_metrics = read.csv("/Users/mattparker/Dropbox/Workspace/moops/manuscript1/data/sequencing_summary_metrics_all.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Process all CSV files and combine them
all_data <- bind_rows(lapply(csv_files, process_csv_file))

# Pond sample names
pond_samples = c("s9","s10","s19","s20")

# Create sample metadata using helper function
sample_metadata = create_sample_metadata(seq_metrics, pond_samples)

# Merge the taxonomy data with metadata
merged_data <- all_data %>%
  left_join(sample_metadata, by = "sample_name")

# Filter to include only species level (tax_level == 1) to avoid duplication
species_data <- merged_data %>%
  filter(tax_level == 1) %>% 
  filter(water_control == "No") %>%   # filter out Negative Controls
  filter(infection_class != "Definite") # filter out positive controls
```

```{r, results='asis'}
cat("\\captionsetup{labelformat=empty}")
# -------------------------
# Calculate viral percentages per sample
# -------------------------
sample_totals <- species_data %>%
  group_by(base_sample, library_prep) %>%
  summarise(
    total_nt_count = sum(nt_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_nr_count = sum(nr_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_nt_rpm   = sum(nt_rpm, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_nr_rpm   = sum(nr_rpm, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

virus_data <- species_data %>%
  filter(category == "viruses", is_phage == "false") 

viral_percentages <- virus_data %>%
  drop_na(base_sample) %>%
  group_by(base_sample, library_prep) %>%
  summarise(
    viral_nt_count = sum(nt_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(sample_totals, by = c("base_sample", "library_prep")) %>%
  mutate(
    viral_nt_percent = (viral_nt_count / total_nt_count) * 100,
    viral_nt_percent = ifelse(is.nan(viral_nt_percent) | is.infinite(viral_nt_percent), NA, viral_nt_percent)
  )

viral_summary <- viral_percentages %>%
  select(base_sample, library_prep, viral_nt_count, viral_nt_percent) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = library_prep,
    values_from = c(viral_nt_count, viral_nt_percent),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{library_prep}"
  )

# -------------------------
# Create seq_metrics_summary_1
# -------------------------
seq_metrics_summary_1 <- seq_metrics_exp1 %>%
  drop_na(base_sample) %>%
  select(base_sample, library_prep, total_reads, passed_filters, compression_ratio) %>%
  group_by(base_sample, library_prep) %>%  # ensure single row per sample+prep
  summarise(
    total_reads = sum(total_reads),
    passed_filters = sum(passed_filters),
    compression_ratio = mean(compression_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = library_prep,
    values_from = c(total_reads, passed_filters, compression_ratio),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{library_prep}"
  ) %>%
  left_join(viral_summary, by = "base_sample") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.list), ~ as.numeric(unlist(.)))) %>%  # convert any list-columns to numeric
  mutate(
    passed_filters_msspe = (passed_filters_MSSPE / total_reads_MSSPE) * 100,
    passed_filters_ngs   = (passed_filters_NGS / total_reads_NGS) * 100
  ) %>%
  select(base_sample, total_reads_NGS, total_reads_MSSPE,
         passed_filters_ngs, passed_filters_msspe,
         compression_ratio_NGS, compression_ratio_MSSPE,
         viral_nt_percent_NGS, viral_nt_percent_MSSPE) %>%
  arrange(desc(viral_nt_percent_MSSPE))

# Table 1: Experiment 1
seq_metrics_summary_1_kbl <- seq_metrics_summary_1 %>%
  rename(
    "Sample" = base_sample,
    "Reads (MSSPE)" = total_reads_MSSPE,
    "Reads (NGS)" = total_reads_NGS,
    "Passed Filter % (MSSPE)" = passed_filters_msspe,
    "Passed Filter % (NGS)" = passed_filters_ngs,
    "DCR (NGS)" = compression_ratio_NGS,
    "DCR (MSSPE)" = compression_ratio_MSSPE,
    "Viral Reads % (MSSPE)" = viral_nt_percent_MSSPE,
    "Viral Reads % (NGS)" = viral_nt_percent_NGS
  ) %>%
  kable(
    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    caption = "Experiment 1: Shallow-sequencing",
    digits = 2,
    align = "lrrr",   # adjust as needed: text left, numbers right
    format.args = list(big.mark = ",")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position"), # polished journal look
    position = "center",
    full_width = TRUE,
    font_size = 9
  ) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%  # strong header
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, latex_hline = "major") # if repeating target names

# -------------------------
# Create seq_metrics_summary_2 (Experiment 3)
# -------------------------

  pivot_wider(

    values_from = c(total_reads, passed_filters, compression_ratio),

  ) %>%
  left_join(viral_summary, by = "base_sample") %>%

  mutate(
    passed_filters_msspe = (passed_filters_MSSPE / total_reads_MSSPE) * 100,
```

```{r}
# Sequencing metrics ALL experiments
seq_metrics_all = sample_metadata %>% 
  filter(water_control == "No") %>%   # Filter out Negative Controls
  filter(infection_class != "Definite") %>%  # Filter out positive controls
  filter(!base_sample %in% c("s5-2")) %>% 
  mutate(
    total_reads_sub = total_reads * subsampled_fraction # Subsample total reads according to subsample fraction
  )

seq_metrics_summary = seq_metrics_all %>%
  drop_na(base_sample) %>%
  select(base_sample, library_prep, total_reads, passed_filters) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = library_prep,
    values_from = c(total_reads, passed_filters),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{library_prep}"
  ) 

seq_metrics_all %>% 
    group_by(library_prep) %>%
    summarize(mean_reads = mean(total_reads),
              mean_reads_sub = mean(total_reads_sub))

seq_metrics_all_long <- seq_metrics_all %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(total_reads, total_reads_sub, passed_filters),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = c("total_reads", "total_reads_sub", "passed_filters")),
         value = value / 1e6, # Convert to millions of reads
    metric = recode(
      metric,
      "total_reads" = "Total reads",
      "total_reads_sub" = "Subsampled reads",
      "passed_filters" = "Reads passed filters"
    )
  )

plot_data <- seq_metrics_all_long %>%
  group_by(library_prep, metric) %>%
  summarize(mean_value = mean(value), .groups = "drop")

overall_barplot = ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = library_prep, y = mean_value, fill = metric)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Total reads" = "#3C8DBC",   # professional blue
      "Reads passed filters" = "#7F8C8D", # neutral gray
      "Subsampled reads" = "#BDC3C7"      # light gray for secondary metric
    ),
    name = ""
  ) + 
  labs(
    title = "a",
    x = "",
    y = "Reads (millions)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

overall_barplot
```

```{r}
library(ggnewscale)
library(RColorBrewer)

# Create boxplot for viral NT percentage by control status
mean_df_viral_perc <- viral_percentages %>%
  group_by(library_prep) %>%
  summarise(mean_value = mean(viral_nt_percent, na.rm = TRUE))

viral_summary_wilcox = viral_summary %>% 
    mutate(
    viral_nt_percent_NGS = replace_na(viral_nt_percent_NGS, 0), # set NAs to 0 for non detections
    viral_nt_percent_NGS   = replace_na(viral_nt_percent_NGS, 0), # set NAs to 0 for non detections
    )

# Paired Wilcoxon test across all samples
wilcox_viral_perc <- wilcox.test(
  viral_summary_wilcox$viral_nt_percent_NGS,
  viral_summary$viral_nt_percent_MSSPE,
  paired = TRUE,
  alternative = "two.sided" 
)

pval_viral_perc <- wilcox_viral_perc$p.value


# get stupid color schemes so I cant make it continuous
blues_palette <- brewer.pal(9, "Blues")  # Get a blues palette with 9 colors
reds_palette <- brewer.pal(9, "Reds")  # Get a reds palette with 9 colors

library_prep_levels <- levels(factor(viral_percentages$library_prep))


viral_nt_boxplot <- ggplot(viral_percentages, aes(x = library_prep, y = viral_nt_percent)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.fill = "white", outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = library_prep), width = 0.1, alpha = 0.7, size = 1.8) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("MSSPE" = "#1f77b4",  # blue
               "NGS"   = "#d62728")  # red
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = mean(1:length(library_prep_levels)), y = max(viral_percentages$viral_nt_percent, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1,
           label = paste0("Wilcoxon p = ", signif(pval_viral_perc, 3)),
           fontface = "italic", size = 4) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "text", aes(label = round(..y.., 1)),
               vjust = -0.5, color = "black", fontface = "bold", size = 3) +
  geom_segment(data = mean_df_viral_perc,
               aes(x = as.numeric(library_prep) - 0.3,
                   xend = as.numeric(library_prep) + 0.3,
                   y = mean_value, yend = mean_value),
               linetype = "dotted", color = "black") +
  geom_text(data = mean_df_viral_perc,
            aes(x = library_prep, y = mean_value, label = paste0("μ: ", round(mean_value, 1))),
            vjust = -1, color = "black", size = 3.2, fontface = "italic") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "b",
    x = "",
    y = "% Viral Reads"
  ) +
  theme(
    #axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
    )


viral_nt_boxplot
```
